subject: Post-call recap & MAP draft for HelioHealth (proposal + milestones)
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & MAP draft for HelioHealth (proposal + milestones)

Hi Sofia — great call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap + attached MAP (helio_MAP_v1.xlsx) so you have a single view:

Summary of discussion:
- Use case: clinical documentation summarization + patient Q&A widget for pilot.
- Success criteria: latency < 600ms P95 for UI flows, 95% redaction coverage for PHI, embedding similarity threshold for retrieval.
- Initial scope: sandbox pilot (2 teams, up to 5k queries/day) -> production rollout if pilot metrics met.

Proposed MAP (high-level milestones):
1) Security & procurement kickoff (owner: Helio procurement) — target: 2026-09-22
2) Architecture workshop (owner: Redwood SE - Marcus) — week of 2026-09-20
3) SOC2 summary and data flow doc delivered (owner: Redwood) — target: 2026-09-22
4) Sandbox POC delivery (owner: Redwood eng) — target: 2026-10-15
5) Pilot validation (joint) — target: 2026-10-25
6) Contract signature & production enablement — target (proposed): 2026-10-01

Dependencies we flagged:
- Procurement approval window and legal redlines (Helio)
- Access to staging API and sample PHI-sanitized dataset (Helio)
- SOC2 evidence/attestation for security team (Redwood to provide summary)

Open asks / next steps:
- Sofia: confirm procurement owners and any blackout dates for September.
- Marcus: propose 2x times for architecture workshop (I put you on the thread).
- Evelyn: can you prepare SOC2 summary + a short redaction sample by 9/22?

I attached helio_MAP_v1.xlsx with milestone rows + owners. If procurement timing looks tight, we can shift the contract target — let me know and we'll produce an updated MAP within 24 hours.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
 david.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: helio_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet: MAP draft)

Thanks for the recap, David — very helpful. A couple of constraints from our side after yesterday's procurement sync:

- Procurement lead (Martin Reyes) is out until 2026-10-04; formal vendor review won't begin until his return. That pushes our likely signature window later.
- Our security team asked for a deeper integration checklist and an explicit data retention plan before we prioritize the POC.

Given that, can we move the contract target to 2026-11-15? If we do that, we would like to reprioritize the MAP so: security/compliance deliverables first, then the POC.

I've attached our procurement timeline (procurement_timeline.pdf) that shows internal checkpoints. Once you send an updated MAP with new dates and owners, I'll route to Martin and the legal team.

David / Evelyn — saw Sofia's note. Proposed adjustments below so we can send a clean MAP back to Helio the same day: 

Proposal (MAP v1.1 changes) — shift to align with procurement availability:
- New contract target: 2026-11-15 (move from 10/01).
- Milestone re-prioritization:
  * Week of 2026-09-20: Architecture workshop (Marcus) — required to get security checklist answered.
  * 2026-09-22: SOC2 summary + DLP/data flow doc (Evelyn) — high priority for Helio security.
  * 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-28: Sandbox POC (Redwood eng) — lower priority until security sign-off.
  * 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-10: Pilot validation window.
  * 2026-11-15: Signature / production enablement.

Redwood responsibilities I recommend we commit to in MAP v1.1:
- Deliver SOC2 summary + sample redaction reports by 2026-09-22 (Evelyn)
- Run architecture workshop and produce action items by 2026-09-25 (Marcus)
- Provide a scoped POC plan (eng estimate + test data needs) by 2026-10-05 (David + eng)

Tradeoffs/offerings to keep momentum:
- Offer a 60-day pilot extension at no extra charge if procurement delay causes late start (helps Helio hit objectives).
- Ensure we include an explicit rollback and data retention clause to address their security concerns.

If that sounds reasonable I can update the MAP spreadsheet and send a version to Sofia. Thoughts?

—Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
